post.x-vms-business-rules: Multipart parts file, reference and purpose, exactly once each. The content must be a valid PDF (header, final %%EOF and a startxref that reaches its cross-reference) for document, or a fully decoding JPEG or PNG of at most 25 megapixels for visitorPhoto. The bytes go to private storage under a server-generated key; form_documents keeps the name, key, type, size and purpose, and support.form_document_uploads the reference, owner, content SHA-256, token hash and one-hour validity. A replay with the same reference and content returns the same token (200) while it is valid; a storage or database failure leaves no usable token.
post.x-vms-resource-authorization: Anonymous. Public uploads share one owner, so the reference and content identify a replay. Overall public 120/min/trusted IP plus 60 new uploads per hour per trusted IP (D31).

x-transport.errorBody: {code, message, requestId, fieldErrors?}; message is the x-error-catalogue text for code; fieldErrors only with validation_failed, keyed by flat form field.
x-transport.noStore: Every /v1/staff response and every error response carries Cache-Control: no-store
x-transport.publicRate: 120 requests per minute per trusted client IP
x-transport.staffRate: 120 requests per minute per employee across sessions
x-transport.timestamps: UTC RFC 3339 with Z; serverTime and timing fields are epoch milliseconds
